placements.title: Capability proven through practice
placements.theme: A capability is only real when it has been exercised, not merely declared.

placements.title: Rehearsal constitutes rollback capability
placements.theme: A rollback is only as real as the rehearsals that exercise it; cadence makes preparedness operational.
placements.why: src-1 directs monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals as operational cadence; src-2 asserts that an unrehearsed rollback is effectively nonexistent. Together they form a thematic statement that rehearsal practice constitutes rollback readiness — a subject future envelopes can keep feeding.
